title: Onboard Orpheus-13B v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description:
This PR onboards Orpheus-13B v1.1 into the model registry and wires up automated performance profiles and changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Orpheus-13B v1.1 contains improved attention fusion and quantization-friendly weights that change latency and memory profiles compared to v1.0. We need accurate metadata, curated perf profiles for our serving runtime, and automated changelog entries so that downstream consumers (hosted API, Dedicated routing, and customers pinning versions) have correct expectations.

What this PR does: adds model metadata JSON, adds performance profile YAMLs for common sequence lengths and hardware classes, extends the changelog automation to include latency/throughput deltas and a short human-readable summary, and updates docs with example rollout notes. All description and changelog content is produced in a single continuous description string elsewhere in the repo; this PR ensures the automation picks up the new model record and generates the appropriate release notes entry.

Risks and mitigations: performance profile is conservative (we include 95th latency and median throughput). We added validation in the changelog generator to require a perf-profile match or the release will fail lint. No customer-facing API changes. The model metadata includes required privacy tags and classification to satisfy Private deployment requirements.
commits:
1) Add metadata file models/metadata/orpheus-13b/v1.1/metadata.json
2) Add perf profiles under models/perf-profiles/orpheus-13b/v1.1/*.yaml (cpu/gpu-small/gpu-large)
3) Update tools/changelog-generator to: include perf deltas, summary templates, and validation hooks
4) Update docs/reference/models.md with example rollout and known-issues
(4 commits, authored by Maya Chen)
